word_report_skeleton.name: Word Report Skeleton
word_report_skeleton.description: Title + headings + body paragraphs — a complete document outline in one pass.
word_report_skeleton.code:
doc_create('report.docx')
doc_add_heading('report.docx', 'Quarterly Report', level=0)
doc_add_heading('report.docx', 'Summary', level=1)
doc_add_paragraph('report.docx', 'Overall performance was on target.')
doc_add_heading('report.docx', 'Details', level=1)
doc_add_table('report.docx', rows=[['Q1', '120'], ['Q2', '135']], headers=['Quarter', 'Revenue'])
